say:1:1033712001:1.text: Look, Magister! Corrupted roots suck the life force out of all nearby plants, causing them to secrete that black fluid.
say:1:1033712001:1.source_cn: 哦，魔法师，您看！腐化根茎会吸取附近所有植物的生命力，...
say:1:1033712001:1.male: Look, Magister! Corrupted roots suck the life force out of all nearby plants, causing them to secrete that black fluid.
say:1:1033712001:1.female: Look, Magister! Corrupted roots suck the life force out of all nearby plants, causing them to secrete that black fluid.

say:2:1033712002:1.text: The longer the black fluid is produced, the darker the soil will become.
say:2:1033712002:1.source_cn: 腐败腥臭的黑色汁水分泌的越久，这片土地的颜色也会变得越深。
say:2:1033712002:1.male: The longer the black fluid is produced, the darker the soil will become.
say:2:1033712002:1.female: The longer the black fluid is produced, the darker the soil will become.

say:3:1033712003:1.text: The earth in Rainford is darker than that of any other corrupted area we've investigated!
say:3:1033712003:1.source_cn: 沐霖村的土地颜色，是我们调查的所有腐化土地中颜色最深的！
say:3:1033712003:1.male: The earth in Rainford is darker than that of any other corrupted area we've investigated!
say:3:1033712003:1.female: The earth in Rainford is darker than that of any other corrupted area we've investigated!

say:4:1033712004:1.text: I can't imagine how much the residents here have suffered...
say:4:1033712004:1.source_cn: 难以想象这里的居民遭受了怎样的痛苦……
say:4:1033712004:1.male: I can't imagine how much the residents here have suffered...
say:4:1033712004:1.female: I can't imagine how much the residents here have suffered...
